description: This file defines naming strategies and utilities for generating consistent type and symbol names within the Kubernetes code generation framework. It includes functions for creating public/private namers, raw namers, and handling type-based name generation with support for package paths and type structures.

classes.name: NameStrategy
classes.description: A configurable strategy for generating type names based on package paths, type structures, and naming conventions.

classes.name: rawNamer
classes.description: A namer implementation that generates names suitable for referencing types directly, optionally tracking import paths.

classes.name: Names
classes.description: A map from *types.Type to string, used to cache generated names.

methods.name: IsPrivateGoName
methods.description: Determines if a given name is considered private in Go (starts with lowercase or is empty).

methods.name: NewPublicNamer
methods.description: Creates a namer that generates CamelCase public names, with options to ignore certain words and prepend package names.

methods.name: NewPrivateNamer
methods.description: Creates a namer that generates camelCase private names, with options similar to NewPublicNamer.

methods.name: NewRawNamer
methods.description: Creates a namer that returns type names as they would be written in code, optionally tracking import paths.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Generates a name for a given *types.Type based on the strategy, handling various type kinds and package paths.
